Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
from collections import Counter

def are_anagrams(first, second):
    return Counter(first) == Counter(second)

assert are_anagrams("listen", "silent")
assert not are_anagrams("aab", "abb")
```
explanation: Compare frequency maps. Expected time O(n+m), auxiliary space O(k); define case and Unicode normalization policy for natural-language text.
